name: Easy Dutch Oven Beef "Cowboy Stew" with Carrot, Potato, Turnip & Bacon Bits

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
While the Dutch oven heats up, pat beef dry with paper towels. Place in a medium bowl, along with flour, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g beef for stew
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the Dutch oven is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. (The beef will not be cooked all the way through.) Using the slotted spoon, remove to a plate, then set aside. (Reserve Dutch oven with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and medium dice onion.
Return the Dutch oven (with drippings) to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, peel, trim, and large dice carrots and turnips. Place both in a clean medium bowl.
Large dice potatoes. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.

When the onion is done, add 1 cup of broth to the Dutch oven and cook, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot, 1-2 minutes. Return beef to the Dutch oven, then add veggies, remaining 2 cups of broth, ketchup, and instant coffee crystals. Stir to combine the stew and cover with a lid. Place Dutch oven in the oven and bake until beef and veggies are tender, about 1 hour 45 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups beef broth
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tsp instant coffee crystals

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide stew between bowls and sprinkle with bacon bits. Enjoy!
